Protected volume V comes from TABULA/VITO Table 19.

definition: Annual-average natural infiltration proxy under normal pressure conditions
evidence_or_assumption: The fixed n-factor 20 is the Kronvall-Persily screening rule documented by AIVC and Sherman; climate height shielding and leakage distribution remain sensitivity dimensions.

definition: Annual-average infiltration airflow proxy under normal pressure conditions
evidence_or_assumption: The same n-factor conversion is applied consistently to every physical state.

formula: H_tr = U_roof*A_roof + U_facade*(A_wall+A_wall_unheated) + U_floor*(A_floor_soil+A_floor_unheated) + U_window*A_window + U_door*A_door
evidence_or_assumption: The screening calculation uses the TABULA areas directly; thermal bridges and boundary reduction factors enter the later thermal model.
The model uses rho_air=1.2 kg/m3 and cp_air=1005 J/(kg K).
Higher z ranks cells with larger transmission and screening infiltration loss per square metre; climate gains controls thermal mass and detailed ventilation enter the later thermal model.

formula: descending current-state z; then physical-state order and TABULA type number for ties
evidence_or_assumption: Medium transitions rank pre-2006 TABULA_existing cells; advanced transitions rank every TABULA_existing and TABULA_standard_B_proxy cell.

definition: Nominal annual regional activity for renovation depth d
evidence_or_assumption: This is the proportional regional disaggregation of the national quota ARR * depthShare(d) * N(BE 2025); ARR uses the fixed 2025 R1-R4 stock denominator.
The national policy projection holds ARR and the 40/50/10 depth distribution constant from 2026 through 2050.

definition: Cumulative physical-state transitions after annual eligibility limits
formula: Sum of annual allocations from 2026 through 2050
evidence_or_assumption: Advanced transitions run before medium transitions each year; unused depth quotas remain within their own depth.

definition: Federal shallow renovation depth represented by the TABULA as-is state
formula: Recorded in activity totals with zero physical-state transition
evidence_or_assumption: TABULA provides no separate shallow envelope package.

definition: Federal medium renovation depth represented by TABULA standard refurbishment
evidence_or_assumption: Post-2005 existing archetypes already achieve the VITO EPB2010 package and remain outside medium-transition eligibility.

definition: Federal advanced renovation depth represented by TABULA low-energy refurbishment
evidence_or_assumption: The federal deep category is mapped to the Belgian TABULA Low Energy envelope package.
Event totals can exceed unique renovated dwellings because a dwelling can progress from existing to standard and later to advanced.

definition: Lower bound on dwellings receiving both medium and later advanced transitions
formula: For each archetype max(0 standard-to-advanced events minus initial standard dwellings)
evidence_or_assumption: The cohort identity within the aggregated standard state is unavailable; the model reports a guaranteed lower bound rather than an exact unique-dwelling count.

definition: Allocation of regional state marginals and their bounds to archetypes
evidence_or_assumption: The categorical row-column independence form is declared because a representative Belgian region-by-archetype-by-state joint table is unavailable.

definition: Source-precision interval around each reported A or B share
formula: reported share plus or minus half the printed unit; Existing = 1 - B - A
evidence_or_assumption: Flemish Brussels and Walloon reported-share half-widths are 0.5 0.005 and 0.05 percentage points respectively; the residual bounds are correlated with A and B.
